A Little Letter for You, Yanisha 💗

(read it slowly, okay? 🩷)

Tap the envelope 💌

Dear Yanisha,

I know our story has only just begun, but I wanted to make something special for you.

I'm really happy that we got this chance to be together, and I hope we get to create so many beautiful memories along the way.

I want us to enjoy the little things, laugh at silly jokes, share our thoughts, support each other, and make ordinary days feel a little more special.

We don't need a perfect relationship or a perfect story. I just hope we can keep understanding each other, being honest, and making each other smile.

Maybe one day, we'll look back at the beginning of our story and smile at how everything started.

Until then, let's take things one day at a time and enjoy the little moments we get to share.

Thank you for choosing me, Yanisha. I'm happy our story has started, and I look forward to the beautiful memories we might create together.

With love,
Your Boyfriend 🩷
